description: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini compatible AI gateway on Cloudflare Workers, with a Pages admin console.
name: free-ai-gateway

scripts.deploy:ui: cd frontend && wrangler pages deploy . --project-name free-ai-gateway-admin
scripts.dev:ui: cd frontend && wrangler pages dev . --binding GW_API_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8787
